T is optimized with respect to NLL on the validation set.

sources.inspection: Read publisher PDF sections directly after extracting with pdftotext. Paper uses right-closed bins; course expressly uses left-closed project convention, compatible with its formula. Positive T is scalar for all classes and unchanged argmax is mathematical, subject to finite-precision ties. The course grid is explicitly a teaching approximation, not Guo continuous optimization.

short_excerpts: For N observations labeled from C possible classes, the Brier score is defined as: (1/N) sum_i sum_c (y_ic - p_ic)^2 [formula transcribed].
In binary classification tasks the Brier score is usually divided by two and then ranges between [0, 1].
